newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cintas upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cintas upgraded to buy.

text.p: - Barrington Research raised to buy from neutral its rating on Cintas Corp, which provides industrial laundry services in 170 of the top 200 markets in the U.S., analyst Alexander Paris Jr. said in a report.

- Cintas recently reported fiscal third quarter earnings of $0.47 a share, $0.01 better than estimates, he said. Earnings rose 21 percent from a year earlier and revenues increased 14.7 percent, to $210 million from $183 million.
- Shares of Cintas were trading up one to 53.
